manifesto.quote: “Anonymity is not a feature — it is the condition that makes honesty possible.”

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subheading: Three steps. Honest from the first moment.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Answer an honest self-assessment. The Mirror helps you see your preparation as it truly is — not as you wish it were.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We connect you with a verified mentor who has lived your exact stage of the journey. No photos. No real names.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Open, honest conversations through shared journals and anonymous chat. One human, sitting with another.

whatIsNot.heading: What Mento is NOT
whatIsNot.subheading: Every feature decision passes this filter. We are one human, anonymously, sitting with another.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: You never see or share a real name or photo. Your profile is a single letter on a coloured tile, plus a randomly generated handle (e.g., Aspirant_8421). Mentors are the same. Our platform is built so that honesty is possible precisely because your identity is never at stake.
faq.a2: Mentors submit their Mains hall ticket (required) and marks sheet (optional) plus an Aadhaar verification. Our team reviews each application manually before granting access. Verified mentors receive a purple tick on their avatar.
faq.a3: Mento has four tiers: FREE (discovery only), BASIC (₹399/mo — open chat + personal journals), PRO (₹599/mo — priority in mentor feed + broadcast requests), and MAX (₹999/mo — 1:1 session credits + verified-mentor priority). Pricing is in validation; your first conversation is always free.
faq.a4: No. Emphatically not. Mento is not coaching, not content, not a doubt-clearing service. We are one human who has walked a hard path turning around to hold a light for the person still walking it. No study material. No recorded lectures. No mock tests.
faq.q5: What happens if I share personal details?
faq.a5: Both parties are banned immediately, with no refund. This is a hard rule — not a guideline. The platform is anonymous because anonymity is the infrastructure that makes honest conversation possible. Breaking it breaks the platform for everyone.
faq.q6: Can I be a mentor and an aspirant at the same time?
faq.a6: Yes. If you have cleared Prelims at least once, you are eligible to mentor someone at an earlier stage while still preparing yourself. The platform will show you both a Mentees tab and a Mentors tab so you can operate in both roles.

finalCta.heading: Find the mentor you needed.
finalCta.subheading: Someone out there is exactly where you were. You can be the person you needed then.
